pages.title: Things With a Previous Life
pages.text: Unusual substances transform creatures, items and building materials.

pages.title: Getting started
pages.text: Spores transform a rabbit; carrots pacify the fungal defender, which cannot breed. Mimicream copies supported damageable items with depleted durability, not a repaired copy. Rainbow Jelly colors reversibly; sponge removes creature color.
